argument_skeleton_first: Finite observation creates the window kernel before an FFT grid is chosen.
Endpoint behavior exchanges central-lobe width for sidelobe behavior.
Coherent gain and scalloping separately calibrate centered and off-bin deterministic tones.
ENBW calibrates white-noise power through squared weights.
A frozen unequal-tone study makes window choice a declared, phase-audited decision.
keeper_numbers: Rectangular: 2-bin null-to-null main lobe and about -13.26 dB peak sidelobe; periodic Hann: 4 bins and about -31.47 dB.
Periodic four-sample Hann: G_c=0.5, C_w=2, and ENBW=1.5 bins.
Weak neighbor: -40 dB at 5.5 original bins, with a required minimum tested-phase margin of 3.000 dB.

convention_freezes.dft: Negative-sign, unscaled forward DFT; 1/N inverse inherited from the prerequisite.
convention_freezes.coherent_gain: G_c=(1/N)sum w[n]; unnormalized response C_w=sum w[n]=N G_c is always named separately.
convention_freezes.main_lobe: Null-to-null distance between first exact nulls, in current-record bin units.
convention_freezes.sidelobe: Peak magnitude outside the first-null interval relative to W(0); far falloff is a separate metric.
convention_freezes.enbw: N sum w[n]^2/(sum w[n])^2 bins; multiply by f_s/N for hertz.
convention_freezes.weak_tone: Noiseless analytic complex tones, N0=128 physical coordinate reference, N in {64,128,256}, fixed frequencies q=20.5 and q=26, sixteen deterministic tested phases, exact-DTFT local neighborhood metric.

checked_math_and_claims.check: The 2pi-periodic convolution carries the required 1/(2pi) factor and follows by inverse-DTFT substitution.
Rectangle, Hann, Hamming, and minimum four-term Blackman-Harris coefficients match the adopted denominator-N contract.

Independent dense direct-DTFT evaluation reproduced rectangle (CG 1, ENBW 1, scalloping 3.9224 dB, width 2, PSL -13.2615 dB), Hann (0.5, 1.5, 1.4236 dB, width 4, -31.4673 dB), Hamming (0.54, 1.362826, 1.7514 dB, width 4, about -42.675 dB), and four-term Blackman-Harris (0.35875, 2.004353, 0.82557 dB, width 8, about -92.01 dB).
w=[0,0.5,1,0.5], sum w=2, sum w^2=1.5, G_c=0.5, ENBW=4(1.5)/4=1.5 bins; a unit matching complex tone gives raw coefficient 2 and corrected amplitude 1.
The one-sided interior-bin real-cosine estimator is 2|X_w[k]|/sum w, with no doubling at DC or even-N Nyquist.
For uncorrelated variance-sigma-squared samples, E|Q_w[k]|^2=sigma^2 sum w^2; after C_w calibration it is sigma^2 B_e/N.
For [1,2,2,1], C_v=6, G_c=1.5, sum squares=10, ENBW=10/9, and tone-calibrated noise penalty relative to rectangle is 10log10(10/9)=0.458 dB.
For N=64 and L=1024, grid spacing is 1/16 original bin and nearest-grid maximum error is 1/32; q=10.3 is nearest 10.3125 with 0.0125-bin error while all window metrics stay fixed.
The lesson reproduces only frozen rows needed to falsify narrowest-is-best and lowest-sidelobe-is-best; all verdicts use unrounded >=3.000 dB and are described as all-tested-phase, not probabilistic.
